heading: Short films
intro: Narrative shorts, most written, directed, and edited independently.

items.title: Half Light
items.blurb: Two estranged siblings spend one power outage rebuilding a bridge they thought was gone.

items.title: Paper Boats
items.blurb: A father teaches his daughter to fold paper boats the summer before he moves out.

items.title: The Last Ferry
items.blurb: Strangers on the final crossing of the night trade secrets they'll never have to keep.
